Package com.google.adk.tools

Class ToolContext

java.lang.Object
com.google.adk.agents.ReadonlyContext
com.google.adk.agents.Context
com.google.adk.agents.CallbackContext
com.google.adk.tools.ToolContext
public class ToolContext extends CallbackContext
ToolContext object provides a structured context for executing tools or functions.

Extends CallbackContext (and through it Context); BaseTool.runAsync(java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.lang.Object>, com.google.adk.tools.ToolContext) and tool callbacks take this type.
